label_note: Labels mark files touched by commits that a heuristic classifies as likely bug fixes. They are not confirmed defects; metrics measure agreement with that heuristic.
limitations: Probabilities come from a logistic regression trained on this repository's own history; they are not validated defect predictions.
The target is 'a commit classified as a likely bug fix touches this file within the horizon', which includes missed and mislabelled fixes.
Check the chronological evaluation before relying on the ranking; with few test positives the metrics are unstable.
Scores describe the latest dataset snapshot, which can be up to one snapshot interval older than the latest commit.
